UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User preferences and Pomodoro timer settings scoped to an authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the profile card (1-80 chars).

hapticsEnabled.description: Whether haptic vibration feedback triggers on timer events.

autoStartBreak.description: Whether break timer starts automatically after a focus session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: An immutable logged Pomodoro focus or break session for daily history and analytics.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

title.description: Session title or linked task name (1-120 chars).

dateKey.description: Local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format for daily aggregation and streak calculation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

FocusTask.title: FocusTask
FocusTask.description: A focusable task with estimated and completed Pomodoro counts.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the task owner.

estimatedPomodoros.description: Planned Pomodoro count for this task (1-20).

completedPomodoros.description: Completed Pomodoro sessions credited to this task (0-100).

completed.description: Whether the task has been marked done.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile and timer preferences document.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Append-only subcollection of completed focus sessions for a user.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Subcollection of Pomodoro tasks owned by a user.
